The '''Bryar pistol''' was a modified [[Bryar rifle]] with its [[Stock/Legends|stock]] and muzzle sawed down. 

This pistol was the preferred weapon of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]-turned [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]] [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Saga1" /> 

==Description==
It was a highly accurate [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] though it was not a very powerful one; and although its power diminished over distance, it retained its accuracy,<ref name="Saga1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> making it a choice for sniping.<ref name="Dark Forces Official Player's Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref> The blaster has an interesting ability to "charge up" and fire one large blast at the expense of its ammunition.

==History==
[[File:Kyletarantino.png|thumb|left|Kyle Katarn's Bryar pistol]]
[[Morgan Katarn]] had a bryar rifle and sawed it down to make it more fashioned. He then gave it to his son Kyle as a parting gift before leaving for the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].<ref name="Saga1" /> Katarn carried it with him after his graduation and his recruitment by the Alliance on the ''[[New Hope]]'' and his first [[Mission to Danuta]], where he was able to find and use other weapons to his arsenal against the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]]. Katarn continued to carry it along the [[Dark Trooper Project|Dark Trooper campaign]].<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> Katarn continued to carry it for his personal protection [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|when he met]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] in the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and continued to carry it even when after he received [[Qu Rahn's lightsaber]], until the [[mission to Ruusan]]. <ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> 
[[File:Katarn_VS_Gorc.jpg|thumb|Gorc walking into a point where he'd be open for Katarn to shoot him.]]
Katarn had even used it to kill [[Gorc]], who had walked straight into the blaster-fire of the bryar pistol 

[[Max (bunny)|Max]], a savage [[bunny]]-like creature, also used a Bryar pistol.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />

Soon after getting adopted into [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training,<ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" /> Katarn continued to carry the blaster as a backup weapon, unlike other Jedi who normally eschewed blasters. He returned to it after severing his ties to the [[New Jedi Order]] and continued to use it extensively.<ref name="Saga1" />

[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], while normally carrying only the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol|DL-44]] as her sidearm, would carry her own Bryar Pistol when assigned to guard a New Republic [[Corvette/Legends|Corvette]].<ref>[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith|Mysteries of the Sith]]</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I got [the name for Bryar pistol] from a composer Gavin Bryars. ''[&hellip;]'' I just liked the name and it sounded great.|Justin Chin|<ref name="Mail">{{EmailCite|email=File:JustinChin-DarkForces.png|creator=[[Justin Chin]]|date=1995-04-29}}</ref>}}
[[File:Max.jpg|thumb|[[Max (bunny)|Max]] armed with his Bryar pistol.]]
The Bryar pistol was created by [[Justin Chin]], owing its name to composer [[Gavin Bryars]].<ref name="Mail" />

The "charge-up" feature of the Bryar pistol was not available until its appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', in which the weapon also fired yellow blaster bolts instead of the red of previous games. This, along with slight variances in the weapon's name throughout the series (''in order: "modified Bryar pistol," "Bryar pistol," "Bryar blaster pistol"''), has led to some ambiguity as to whether it was a new model in the Bryar line or the same gun used in the previous games.

Despite usually being associated with Kyle, (and the only other user of it previously being the non-canon Max) Mara Jade starts Mission 9 of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' with the Bryar pistol in her inventory alongside her DL-44.
